tools.name: list_funds
tools.description: Lists all 13 VistaShares ETFs with ticker, name, family, exchange, CUSIP, inception date, expense ratio, net assets (with as-of date), description and key document links. Optional family filter.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.description: Key facts for one VistaShares ETF as published on its fund page, each with its as-of date: objective, CUSIP, exchange, inception date, expense ratio, net assets, shares outstanding, number of holdings, distribution frequency, holdings, distributions and documents.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.description: Holdings of a VistaShares ETF as published on its fund page (name, ticker, market value and weight), with the as-of date.

tools.name: get_distributions
tools.description: Distribution calendar and history of a VistaShares ETF (declaration, ex, record and payable dates and per-share amounts) as published on the fund page. Funds without distributions return an empty list.

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: Links to the prospectus, summary prospectus, SAI, fact sheet, reports and Section 19(a) notices for a VistaShares ETF.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Searches the published VistaShares FAQs (fund pages, fund family pages and About) and returns matching questions and answers with their source page.

tools.name: covered_call_outcome
tools.description: Shows what a covered call position returns for a given stock move, call strike and option premium, compared with owning the stocks alone. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/covered-call-calculator/.

tools.name: buffer_outcome
tools.description: Shows the outcome of a buffered position for a given index return, buffer size and cap over one outcome period. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-calculator/.

tools.name: buffer_payoff_table
tools.description: Returns the payoff of a buffered position across index returns from -40% to +30%, for a chosen buffer, cap and share of losses kept beyond the buffer. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-payoff-chart/.

tools.name: buffer_options_builder
tools.description: Explains, step by step, how owning an index plus buying a put, selling a lower put and selling a call creates a buffered payoff (10% buffer, 12% cap example), with payoff values for each step. Same content as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-options-builder/.

tools.name: buffer_mid_period
tools.description: For someone buying a buffer ETF partway through its outcome period: remaining upside to the cap, how far the index must fall before the buffer starts, and how much buffer is left, given the index and fund moves since the period began. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-mid-period-ca

tools.name: loss_recovery
tools.description: Shows the gain needed to recover from a given loss (a 50% loss needs a 100% gain), and what $100,000 becomes after the loss. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/loss-recovery-calculator/.

tools.name: etf_cost
tools.description: Estimates the dollar cost of holding an ETF: expense ratio over a holding period plus the bid-ask spread paid when buying and later selling. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/etf-cost-calculator/.

tools.name: supercycle_spending
tools.description: Where the money goes in five infrastructure buildouts: a 1 GW AI data center, global power sector investment, the U.S. defense budget request, the global space economy and a humanoid robot bill of materials. Each row has a value, share and description, with the cited source. Same data as https://www

tools.name: ai_supply_chain_layers
tools.description: The six layers of the AI supply chain (chips, memory, networking, servers, data centers, power and grid), each with a short description and a VistaShares guide link. Same content as https://www.vistashares.com/ai-supply-chain-map/.
